name: Crushing Pressure, Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level psychic 7, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

EFFECT

Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 20)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as crushing pressure except it affects multiple targets.
